thesis: GMAB is a high-quality, cash-generative uptrend (above SMA20/50/200, strong RS63, sector XLV leading in a risk-off tape) digesting its October re-rating, with no earnings or binary event inside the window. However, the 64.4 target sits beyond the 59.97 52-week high, so the trade pays only on a breakout made on a 0.77 volume ratio with RSI 68.9, in a risk-off regime (0.9) and a thin half-day session. Reward/risk is 1.55 only at the 55.9 zone midpoint and about 1.19 at the 56.80 last close, and both debaters' own odds (bull 0.30 to target, bear 0.35 to 50.24) put the probability of target-before-stop below the roughly 0.39 breakeven, so no new position.
invalidation: A daily close below 50.24, or back below the 20-day SMA (~53.8) on expanding volume, voids the continuation thesis. An upgrade needs a volume-confirmed hold above 59.97, with levels rebuilt by the technical card.
key_risks: Breakout-dependent target: a target at the 59.97 high alone gives about 0.7 R/R
Risk-off regime (confidence 0.9) with QQQ below its 50/200-day averages, plus thin half-day liquidity that makes the stop fill unreliable
Extended run (+110% in 126 days, RSI 68.9) on unconfirmed volume, at rich valuation (trailing P/E 48.5, forward 35.9)
Darzalex royalty cliff overhang and earnings growth of -14.7% against revenue growth of +16.1%, with an empty SEC quarterly series
A possible equity raise after the run-up (not ruled out by the news card)
